issue: Problem with a purchase shown on your statement
narrative: I found a charge on my Discover card statement in XX/XX/2017. A purchase of {$950.00} to a mower shop in another state around XX/XX/2017. At the time I was using the card along with my son to help him move out of state for college, was a very stressful time when a child moves away and never noticed the charges until several months later. I called Discover and disputed the unauthorized charges and they immediately refunded me. A month later I get a call from Discover that they couldn't identify the purchase as fraud so they put the interest and charges back on my account. So I did my own investigation gathered all the XXXX shipping statements called the merchant then sent all this to discover. They did nothing and lead me on thinking they are doing an investigation but all along they did everything to avoid me. So far no phone call no email nothing. I called again and got the same answer will open another investigation 3rd one! no one there can explain or give me a reason why they wont refund the fraud charge other then being several months old. Every other credit card would contact you for suspected fraud if a XXXX dollar purchase was done. They are suppose to have a zero fraud guaranty. They don't want to deal with talking to customers or help them out in anyway. They rather get you off the phone to give you a false set hope they are investigating the issues but all along just putting me off. I've been in customer service for 30 years and I never had such horrible customer service then discover card. They lie there is no such thing as zero fraud guaranty!
